counts.sentence: report counts are not failure rates

release.description: AI copilot for medical device quality investigations on public FDA data: failure-mode trends, early-warning signals, recalls, cited answers (Claude Haiku 5.5) and per-investigation memory. Honest evaluation, verified at every phase.
